INSERT INTO v5ai_knowledge_chunk (knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, metadata, token_count, content_hash, source_type, vector_id, keyword_tokens, updated_at) VALUES
( #{item.knowledgeBaseId}, #{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content}, -- 核心修复点：加上 jdbcType=OTHER，告诉 MyBatis 不要当字符串传 #{item.metadata, jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb, #{item.tokenCount}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.vectorId}, #{item.keywordTokens, typeHandler=xin.v5ai.nb.rag.core.store.TextArrayTypeHandler}, current_timestamp )
ON CONFLICT (vector_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, token_count = EXCLUDED.token_count, content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, keyword_tokens = EXCLUDED.keyword_tokens, updated_at = current_timestamp

SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, metadata, vector_id, content_hash, source_type FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE vector_id IN
#{vid}

SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, metadata, vector_id, content_hash, source_type, keyword_tokens FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE AND keyword_tokens && #{terms, typeHandler=xin.v5ai.nb.rag.core.store.TextArrayTypeHandler} ORDER BY cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(keyword_tokens) INTERSECT SELECT unnest(#{terms, typeHandler=xin.v5ai.nb.rag.core.store.TextArrayTypeHandler}))) DESC, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE AND cardinality(keyword_tokens) > 0
SELECT COALESCE(avg(cardinality(keyword_tokens)), 0) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE AND cardinality(keyword_tokens) > 0
SELECT count(*) FROM v5ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE AND keyword_tokens @> ARRAY[#{term,jdbcType=VARCHAR}]::text[]
